answer: Challenge-chain bond: each agent locks 70, enters a chain of nine hollow links, seeded by the last hash. At its tide, the agent fills its hollow with a solution and a copper seal. Auditors replay it: a reused link, a skipped tide, or a shared copper seal burns it. One chain per fake: first 45, kth 45+6(k-1); 1,000 pay 3,042,000 plus 70,000 bonds on a 40,000 pool. A rented-chain ring fails on shared keys. Honest agents pay 45, keep their bonds.
